desc: Parse input and store the M sorted bad intervals.
Maintain reachable set as a list of disjoint intervals [l, r] of positions we can stand on (initially just position 1).

For each bad interval [L, R]: advance reachable intervals by repeatedly expanding (from interval [l,r], reachable positions become [l+A, r+B], merge overlaps), then remove any parts intersecting [L, R]; also cap positions at N.
Optimization: bounded expansion with full-extension rule (interval length ≥ A ⇒ extends to zone end); keep trailing window of size B so direct jumps over tiny zones/bad intervals aren't lost.
After processing all bad intervals, expand once more and check if N is reachable.
Implement final code including A==B special case (step d: Yes iff (N-1)%d==0 and no bad interval contains a position ≡1 mod d), write to stdout, and sanity-check on the three samples.
Verify edge cases: M=0, N small relative to A, zones of length 1, jumps spanning multiple tiny zones (window-of-B correctness), and confirm 45-round cap suffices for worst case A=19, B=20.
